owner_decision_required: Do not change the private-preview gate until the checklist is complete and the owner chooses keep-private or bounded beta.

confirmed: The documented request header is x-api-key
Feed and offer endpoints are documented
The documented throttle is 1 request per second, burst 10, and quota 1000 requests per day
does_not_confirm: A license to republish or commercially exploit returned data
Permission to retain historical derivatives, display prices/images, or send alerts

confirmed: The public terms limit access to personal and non-commercial use
The public terms prohibit collection and use of product listings, descriptions, or prices and derivative use without express written consent
The public terms prohibit data mining, robots, or similar data-gathering tools
does_not_confirm: SearchWoot-specific permission or an API agreement overriding these restrictions

confirmed: Woot directs API-key requests through its developer request process
Woot asks API users with issues to provide the HTTP status and JSON error response
does_not_confirm: Commercial redistribution, public display, or affiliate/advertising rights

confirmed: API-key authentication and feed/offer endpoints are documented
The portal documents a 1 request/second rate, burst 10, and daily quota 1000
Woot's current public terms do not grant the rights needed for SearchWoot's proposed public data product
not_confirmed: An API agreement or written permission allowing SearchWoot to store, derive, publicly display, cache, or alert on the returned data
Field-level attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, and affiliate-use terms
authoritative_evidence.note: The official API documentation proves an access mechanism, not redistribution rights. The current public terms point the other way for commercial/public data use. Keep the launch gate blocked until Woot provides a current agreement or written permission and Legal records the exact permitted fields, retention, display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, and takedown rules.
authoritative_evidence.next_action: Prepare a written request to Woot through the official API-support/developer process asking for SearchWoot-specific commercial/public-display permission; do not send it or change the private gate without owner approval.

tracking.execution_rule: Open evidence tasks are reviewed each cycle; routine read-only evidence work may proceed through the existing executive research/evidence path, while production, spend, data-collection, or legal-risk changes still require their normal gates.
tracking.completion_rule: Close only when every applicable task has evidence, Legal has issued a disposition for each data-use item, Security/CTO/CFO gates are satisfied, and the owner has selected the next disposition.

tasks.title: Verify Woot source rights and data-use limits
tasks.deliverable: Record the current API terms or written permission, field-level provenance, permitted caching/display/alert use, attribution requirements, freshness limits, and correction/takedown process.
tasks.next_action: Locate the authoritative public terms or permission record and attach the evidence to the checklist.

tasks.title: Document alert-data flow and retention
tasks.deliverable: Map alert rules, access/session identifiers, sync results, Slack/email delivery, retention, deletion, correction, access, and unsubscribe behavior.
tasks.next_action: Produce a read-only data-flow and retention table from the repository and deployed configuration.

tasks.title: Verify analytics consent and GA4 settings
tasks.deliverable: Capture consent/withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention, vendor disclosure, and intended jurisdiction treatment.
tasks.next_action: Run a read-only consent/configuration evidence capture; do not enable new tracking or advertising.

tasks.title: Inventory logs, vendors, and data incident handling
tasks.deliverable: Identify log fields, retention/access controls, Cloudflare and other vendor terms/DPA coverage, incident response, breach, and data-subject request procedures.
tasks.next_action: Produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify any counsel-required gaps.

legal_scope.purpose: Review whether each data source and processing purpose is allowed for the proposed beta, what disclosures or consent are required, and where human counsel must decide.
legal_scope.limitation: Risk triage only; this does not provide legal advice, certification, or acceptance of risk for the owner.

data_use_review.source: Woot API deal and price-history data
data_use_review.purpose: Index, search, compare, and display live deal information and historical price context.
data_use_review.processing: Fetch, store, refresh, transform, display, and include in alerts.
data_use_review.monetization_or_sharing: Potential public display and possible future affiliate or advertising use; none is approved by this checklist.
questions_for_legal: Do the source terms and API agreement permit storage, historical derivatives, public display, caching, and alerts?
Are trademarks, product images, prices, availability, and savings claims used within permitted limits?
What attribution, disclaimer, freshness, correction, takedown, or rate-limit requirements apply?
Would affiliate links or advertising change the rights, disclosure, or platform-policy analysis?
evidence_needed: current API terms or written permission

data_use_review.source: User alert rules and sync results
data_use_review.purpose: Save a user's watch criteria and deliver matching deal alerts.
data_use_review.processing: Store, evaluate, and transmit alert criteria and matching results.
data_use_review.monetization_or_sharing: No sale or retargeting is approved; optional Slack delivery is configured by the operator.
questions_for_legal: What personal-data and processor obligations apply to alert rules, access identifiers, and delivery metadata?
Are retention, deletion, access, correction, and user-request workflows sufficient for the proposed audience and jurisdictions?
Do Slack delivery and any future email delivery require additional consent, terms, or processor disclosures?

data_use_review.purpose: Measure aggregate traffic and product usage after an explicit analytics choice.
data_use_review.processing: Load GA4 only after consent; use IP anonymization and avoid intentionally sending search terms, deal titles, or user IDs.
data_use_review.monetization_or_sharing: Measurement only; no retargeting or sale of personal information is approved.
questions_for_legal: Is the consent experience, withdrawal path, cookie description, and regional treatment sufficient for the intended beta audience?
Are the GA4 configuration, data-sharing settings, retention, vendor terms, and privacy disclosures accurately documented?
Does any future advertising, remarketing, or customer matching require a separate review?

data_use_review.source: Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data
data_use_review.purpose: Operate, secure, debug, and monitor the service.
data_use_review.processing: Collect and retain runtime, security, access, and error information through the hosting and operations stack.
data_use_review.monetization_or_sharing: Operational use only; no public disclosure or secondary monetization is approved.
questions_for_legal: What personal or device data can appear in logs, and what retention, access, deletion, and incident obligations apply?
Are Cloudflare and any other vendors correctly disclosed and covered by current terms or agreements?
What breach, subpoena, abuse, or data-subject request process is required?

non_legal_gates.acceptance: Document source refresh, stale-data labels, correction handling, and rollback behavior before public exposure.
Reconcile traffic, affiliate clicks, orders, commission, and direct costs to site/content identifiers before claiming ROI.
Complete the access, secret, isolation, TLS, dependency, monitoring, incident, and disclosure checklist.

decision_rule: Keep private until every applicable legal data-use item has a Legal disposition, material uncertainty is escalated to human counsel, and the technical, security, accuracy, and measurement gates are complete.
